ios.desc:
Remember those late-night talks where a random question somehow led to the best conversations?

We made that into an app.

Unspoken is a text-only social app where everyone gets the same question every day. Answer however you want: be funny, profound, unhinged, anything. Then see what everyone else had to say.

No photos. No filters. Just what you actually think.

HOW IT WORKS
Every day, at the same time, a new question drops for everyone.
Write your answer, check out what others wrote, react, comment, and engage. At the end of each day, the answers people connect with most rise to the top.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR STORY
Over time, your profile becomes a collection of your answers: your thoughts, stories, intricacies, and everything that makes you unique. Kind of like a peek into your inner world.

FEATURES
- A new curated question every single day
- Text-only: no pressure to look perfect
- 30+ reactions and threaded comments
- Nominate friends to answer specific questions
- Leaderboards and karma points
- Home screen and lock screen widget
- Share answers to Instagram, iMessage, and more
- Voice dictation for hands-free answers

Your best stories are the ones you haven't shared…yet :)

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

I'm thrilled to share with you Unspoken, a social app that features an intriguing question daily that encourages users to share their thoughts, personal stories, and true selves. By doing so, it helps people reveal a more authentic/interesting side of them, as well as find common ground with others. It's available for free here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unspoken-fun-daily-questions/id6448198433

While the concept is as simple as it gets, I think it truly stands out from other popular social apps. Here’s why:

1. Unlike most of its competitors (if not all), Unspoken is text-only. This gives people a break from visually-overwhelming social apps, and attracts those looking for less superficial, more meaningful interactions. Plus, answering a question is easy and feels more approachable than curating the perfect photo, removing some of the friction behind posting.

2. It has an excellent balance of app-generated content (questions) and user-generated content (answers). This allows it to be flexible and improve the questions over time depending on what resonates more with the community, leading to better engagement and retention.

3. People don’t know what tomorrow’s question will be, making the answers more spontaneous, authentic and less curated. This removes the pressure of “planning” the perfect post, which is incredibly refreshing. And, the intrigue of what question comes next adds an exciting element of surprise.
